【原视频简介】
Is "Toe-In" or "Toe-Out" more stable on a tailwheel airplane? I got into a heated debate with my friends about this. They were headstrong that toe-in provides better directional stability, while I was convinced that toe-out is the secret to a well-behaved taildragger. Neither side would back down — So I tested it. 
I put both alignments to the test to see exactly how they handle ground loops, swerves, and tracking. 

Which side are you on? Drop your theories in the comments 

OpenPPG results are found here for anyone that wants to read them. 
and the video here. https://youtu.be/4H52ve4J_8c
